messages.subject: error with skeletor
parts:
Hi all.

I have the following error 

cleaned_downstream_skeletons= skeletor('720575940388728662', brain = elmr::FAFB14.surf,method = 'wavefront',waves = 1)
Warning in try_with_time_limit(suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(py_skeletor(x,  :
  Error in knn(p, query = p, k = k.soma.search, eps = 0, searchtype = 1L,  :
  Requesting more points (10) than available in cloud (4)

Failed: 720575940388728662
Warning in skeletor("720575940388728662", brain = elmr::FAFB14.surf, method = "wavefront",  :
  1 ids could not be read and converted to skeletons

it was working just fine a few weeks ago.

Best
Ibo

messages.author: 7f0257cd1389289f
messages.subject: Re: [nat-user] error with skeletor
parts:
Hi Ibo,

That’s a pain. The function hasn’t changed recently afaics. Is this definitely the same neuron? There is a poorly handled edge case here in the functionality trying to reroot the neuron on the soma. If you don’t need that then set reroot=F and everything should just work. If you do need to reroot, try reducing the value of 

k.soma.search = 10
From its default value to eg 4. I’ll see with Alex Bates about a patch but he’s away just now. All the best,

Greg. 

Sent from my iPhone
